BEFORE YOU BEGIN

Your questions.
Considered.

A practical starting point for your electrical infrastructure enquiry.

What documents support an electrical infrastructure enquiry?

Share the single-line diagram, load schedule, electrical layouts, equipment specifications and bill of quantities where available. Include the project location and programme so site interfaces can be considered.

Can the scope include earthing and bonding?

Earthing and bonding can be defined as part of the electrical installation scope. The design, material requirements, interfaces and testing deliverables should be identified in the project specification and quotation.

How are responsibilities between contractors defined?

Use a scope matrix or clearly itemised quotation to identify who supplies, installs, connects, tests and documents each element. This is particularly helpful for foundations, trenching, panels, utility connections and final reinstatement.
